reason: Conversation 1 opened by wrongly claiming 4C had no documented meaning and misidentifying the appliance as a washer-dryer, wasting a turn and undermining trust, though it then recovered with a sensible safe sequence (unplug, tap off, towels) and reached the filter fix. Conversation 2 correctly explained 4C immediately, laid out the right diagnostic order (tap, pressure, hose, then inlet mesh filter) with proper isolation steps, picked up on the street-works/brown-water clue to pinpoint the cause, and gave accurate escalation criteria (inlet valve only if filter clean and flow good) with no unjustified part recommendation. Both ended correctly with no parts needed, but 2 was more efficient, more accurate throughout, and gave better follow-up advice (flush supply, check for drips, re-check filter if sediment recurs).
